name: Euro circulating coin to labelled denomination recess

allowed: drop a coin in from above
lift a coin out through the finger notch
constrained: a coin entering a recess of a smaller denomination

assembly.direction: swept in from the slope by hand
assembly.sequence_notes: Every recess is open-topped and reachable by one adult finger.

dimensions.feature: recess diameter = coin nominal plus process clearance
smallest diameter step in the set, 10c 19.75 to 2c 18.75 = 1.00 mm

environment_and_variation.environment: dry adult indoor desk or entryway

keepouts_and_access: No secure storage, authentication, counting-machine, child-use or financial-protection claim.
Worn, foreign, commemorative and damaged coins are out of scope.

evidence.uncertainty_note: Calibration registry returns NO_MATCHING_PROCESS for Anycubic Kobra 3 Max / SUNLU PETG / 0.4 mm; hole_delta_vertical and xy_clearance_sliding are UNQUALIFIED. Recess diameters must not be committed until a coupon qualifies the hole delta on this exact process. The binding geometric risk is the 1.00 mm step between 2c and 10c: the clearance must be smaller than half that step or the denominations cross-enter.

failure_modes.mode: Clearance exceeds half the 1.00 mm 2c/10c step and a 2c coin drops into the 10c recess.
failure_modes.effect: Sorting fails; the product does not do its one job.
failure_modes.mitigation: Qualify the hole delta by coupon, then verify the 2c/10c pair explicitly on the tightest coupon.

failure_modes.mode: Recess is too tight and a coin cannot be lifted out.
failure_modes.mitigation: Finger notch on every recess plus a minus/nominal/plus coupon series.

acceptance_criteria: Each denomination enters its labelled recess without force and can be removed by the finger notch.
No coin enters a recess of a smaller denomination, verified explicitly on the 2c/10c pair.
